_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Kai dan wasa {player_id} ne a cikin Tic Tac Toe.
Buri naka shine ya lashe uku a jere (a kwance, tsaye, ko a diagonal) a kan allo.
A lokacin da zaka yi wasa, yakamata ka zabi lambar muraba (0-8) da kake so ka sa alama naka a ciki.
Misali, '[4]' ya sa alama naka a cikin sel na tsakiyar allo.
A matsayin dan wasa {player_id}, zaka kasance '{symbol}', yayin da abokin hamayyar ka shine '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Matsayin da aka gabatar bai bi tsari daidai ba.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ba shi da inganci. Dole ne ya kasance tsakanin 0 da 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} an riga an shagaltar da shi.

game_action.placed: Mai kunnawa {player_id} sanya alamar su ({symbol}) a cikin tantanin halitta {cell} .
